description: Every spawnRun wrapper must thread the boot-resolved runtimeProvider: bootScheduler, createPlanRunSpawn, and createMergePollerDispatch omitted it, so under WARREN_RUNTIME=k8s all cron/scheduled/plan-run/planner dispatches fell back to LocalProvider and failed never_started against the absent burrow socket, retrying every 60s tick (~200 failed runs in 3h on GKE). Same class as warren-c531 (bridges/poller/watchdog).
resolution: Threaded runtimeProvider through all three spawn wrappers + boot wiring (server/main/index.ts, detector-wiring.ts); regression tests assert the provider instance reaches spawnRun. When adding a new spawnRun call site, mirror how POST /runs threads runtimeProvider.

description: warrenCommitIdentityArgs() ('-c user.name=...') loses to inherited GIT_AUTHOR_NAME/GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL env — git exports those to pre-commit hooks, so this repo's own hook (check:all -> bun test) deterministically fails clone-apply.test.ts 'commits as the warren bot' on every local commit. Repro: GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=x bun test src/runs/reap/clone-apply.test.ts.
resolution: Open as warren-035c: add warrenCommitIdentityEnv() and pass explicit GIT_AUTHOR_/GIT_COMMITTER_ env at the four bot-commit sites. Until it lands, a commit whose direct check:all run is green may need --no-verify with justification.

title: Plot extracted from RuntimeProvider.finalize + reap + spawn (warren-39e3)
rationale: Deletion-pass step 7 of pl-3a79: plot must leave the finalize seam before plot core is deleted (warren-b8bf). Both providers + shared contract move in one commit or typecheck breaks.

name: finalize-feature-neutral-stages
description: Finalize contract is feature-neutral (warren-357c): FinalizeIntent.commit is string[] over the same opaque artifact keys as artifacts (default = artifacts); FinalizeStage names derive via finalizeMergeStage/finalizeCommitStage in src/runtime/finalize-stages.ts (split out of contract.ts for the size budget, re-exported there). Wire intake validates shape via isFinalizeStage, not a fixed list. seeds_mirror/plans_mirror renamed to seeds_merge/plans_merge; ReapStep keeps its own vocabulary, mapped in src/runs/reap/pipeline.ts finalizeStageToReapStep.

content: src/runtime/contract.ts derives RunPhase=RunState, MessagePriority=InboxPriority, Message.state=InboxState, NormalizedEvent.stream=EventStream|null from src/core/wire.ts; src/runtime/k8s/log-parse.ts and src/runtime/local/stream.ts use EVENT_STREAMS rather than a private NORMALIZED_STREAMS tuple. scripts/check-wire-types.ts matches on NAMES, so a differently-spelled parallel copy (RunPhase written out as five literals) is invisible to the guard — the convention is alias, never re-list. Widening DOMAIN_STEMS does not help: every canonical export in wire.ts already carries a stem. src/runtime/contract.test.ts pins the derivations.

name: salvage-intake-hardening
description: warren-adc1: per-run in-flight caps reuse the EventStreamLimiter per-key limiter (src/server/stream-limits.ts) keyed on run id with maxPerClient 1 / maxGlobal 0 / no lifetime, rejecting with the family's 503 + Retry-After shape; tmp-file staging (write + rename) must be wrapped in try/finally with rm(force).catch() so failed writes never leak staged files onto the control-plane volume.
